Our vision is to assist Australians in becoming less reliant on the grid, and spending your money on more important things than bills from your retailer.We are confident that our experts are the most knowledgeable in the industry; educating our clients and helping them make an informed decision. company_info.specializations: designing precise solar solutions for homes, farms and businesses

reviews.review_description: Saad and his team were highly professional. The sales process was very accommodating, the system was explained well and our needs taken into consideration. Saad was patient even with a few design changes and we didnt feel pressured into a decision like with other companies. The install team was polite and professional, a thorough pre start meeting and after install walkthrough was held to ensure the install met our needs and we unserstood the system. The team was very efficient installing a 17.6kw system and 32kwh battery system in 8hrs and 13.2kw system to our display home in only 3 hrs. The planning process was welel thought out to set the install team up for success. The after sales service was great too. system seems to be performing excellently. Overall a very pleasant experience and would recommend Beyond Solar to anyone.

We were return customers to Beyond Solar as they had previously installed our solar panels. This time I liaised with Saad from the initial quote to installation. He patiently answered my questions and provided a quote that outlined my requirements. Installation happened in a day, the Beyond Solar team were courteous and efficient. Saad ran through everything I needed to understand the system, and after 2 weeks I can say that I'm very happy with the SigEn battery and its performance.

Everything went smoothly, from the initial consultation with the very responsive Saad to the neat and efficient addition of a battery and a new inverter to an existing solar system. All of my questions were answered clearly both before and after the installation. The quote was also the most competitive of the three that I received. (It included the trade-in of the old inverter.)

From the get go Saad was helpful, informative and kept us up to speed.The installation went according to schedule.Installers were polite and answered my numerous questions.We  had used Beyond Solar at our previous house several years ago and were happy so we chose them again

Just had my 16kw Sigenstor battery installed AC coupled. Saad made the process really easy, straight up guy without any pushy sales tactics, also had a lot of strong technical knowledge as well. Battery was installed by Sam and his team and everything went flawlessly. I'm only a couple of days in with the new battery but really excited. Beyond have been more than happy to answer my questions quickly. Couldn't recommend Beyond enough, seriously guys thank you.

Very efficient on all fronts - strong recommendation from us as novices in this area for Beyond Solar. Good sales person (who actually had experience in solar installations) who was patient and knowledgeable. Products they utilise were on the SolarQuotes table of acceptable units  and the price they quoted was competitive.Installers turned up on the date agreed, took away our old system and replaced it with the new one all in a day. We are at a remote location and they drove for two hours to get to us. Impressive.We also had a battery installed - our only issue was that we bought a smaller one than they suggested - our fault. They did however talk me into a scalable battery so we will be upgrading to a 25.6kw battery once we have saved up!!Terrific people to work with - they left the place looking like a new pin.Strongly recommend anyone thinking of solar should get a quote from them.

Got my solar system installed recently through Beyond Solar, and honestly couldn’t be happier with the whole experience. They gave me a really competitive quote and took the time to explain everything in detail, which made the whole process super easy to understand.They also helped me sort out the financing through Brighte, which was a huge plus. The installation itself was neat and tidy — the team arrived right on time at 9am and wrapped up everything by 3pm. Very efficient! They even set up my app and walked me through how to use it.I went with 13.2kW Longi panels, a 24.17kWh Sig Energy battery, along with Sig Gateway. Everything looks great and is running perfectly so far.Big thanks to Saad (from sales team) and Christian (the electrician) — both were super helpful and professional throughout. Highly recommend Beyond Solar if you’re thinking about getting solar installed!

I can't say enough good things about my experience with Beyond Solar. From start to finish, the service was truly excellent, and the entire process was completely hassle-free and seamless.The quoting process with our representative, Saad, was transparent and straightforward. His experience in the field was evident, and he provided great options that were perfectly suited to our needs. He took the time to truly understand our requirements, which made us feel confident in our choices.The installation was done on time, exactly as promised. The team was fantastic—professional, efficient, and very tidy. The entire process was quick and clean, with zero disruption to our day. It was also reassuring to know that the installers are a core part of the Beyond Solar team and not subcontractors.Beyond Solar is a top-notch company that provides not only a competitive quote but also a truly professional and high-quality service. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking to install solar.

A++++ fixed problems left over from a previous installer with my initial 30kw battery. They brought a 50kw and setup for full home backup which the clowns before couldn’t achieve. Fantastic service and workman ship was just 10000%
I’ve commented as to service above. They know their job inside out, giving the wealth of their expertise in location of plant etc.
Great communication and service from the sales enquiry to the installation and commissioning. Friendly, polite, tidy, punctual and efficient.

Great experience working with Beyond Solar. From the very first consultation with Saad to the final flip of the switch, their team was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly efficient. Saad helped me through every step of the process, answered all my silly questions with patience, and delivered exactly what they promised.Installation was quick and clean, with zero disruption to my daily life. The crew showed up on time, worked diligently, and left my property spotless.Since the system went live, I’ve seen a dramatic drop in my energy bills. This is the second time I went with Beyond Solar for my new home, so if you’re considering going solar, I highly recommend Beyond Solar.

The team were great. We hit a hiccup mid-install when the NSW govt pulled the rebates, but this was beyond anybody's control and they kept me informed throughout. They were the most affordable provider I consulted and I believe they use their own installers, not sub-contractors, so they were able to come out quite quickly.
From the quote, to the installation to the after service was all completed within the expected timeframe and with excellent communication throughout.

Everyone at Beyond solar was very helpful through my solar journey, providing lots of options for all my ideas and then helping me decide which products would be most suitable and what I really needed or could do without.Installation went well, the installers are from my area and everything was completed in a tidy manner.I was comfortable knowing how long they have been installing in NSW/ACT, and that the installation teams are not subcontractors but Beyond Solar employed.Very friendly team everything went smoothly and installed within a few weeks from ordering.

The whole process from the time I spoke them to the time of installation was very pleasant. They kept me in the loop throughout. The installation team was tidy and efficient. I definitely recommend beyond solar for anyone after quality solar.

In 2024 we looked at getting a system for our house, My wife was always looking at getting a a local installer to do our system but an old mate recommended Beyond. It took some convincing to use an installer out of town, as we were worried about things breaking, but Beyond have been very responsive and I'm happy to say since the install my bills are now almost a third and no issues at all.

The sales and quoting process was seamless with Saad, the head of Residential PV at Beyond Solar. He was very polite and informative, ensuring I was prepared for my installation and understood exactly how to calculate and predict my savings.Professional installation team, I felt very secure going with a company that has been around for so long (15 Years in South West Sydney)The installers are locals, friendly and it was as though they were working in their own home. Showed me the wifi app and how to understand my energy usage and solar production.Very excited to be self sustainable and will be coming back for a battery after the federal battery rebate becomes available.

From the outset Saad got back to me quickly, asked me appropriate questions & ascertained how many kws we needed.  His manner was always very professional &  very knowledegeable & also very patient.  In fact he was quite reassuring & the quote was easy to read & quite transparent.  Later there was an add on cost because our older elecrical box needed to be reconfigured.  Last Wednesday the team came down & installed the solar system which consisted of 27 Trina solar panels & Tesla Powerwall 3 combined battery/inverter.  It took 91/2 hours.  The men worked like a well oiled machine, only stopping I think for 15 minutes to eat their lunch. We greatly admired their work ethic.  The whole installation went very smoothly & looked very professional.  When finished Hussain their team leader showed us how to instal the Tesla App on our mobiles & answered any questions we had , he was great.  The next day we were importing 91% our own electricity - very exciting.  We would highly recommed Beyond Solar.

I did extensive research for months and finally settled on Beyond Solar to install our solar solution and battery. We got a 12kw solar panel system and a Tesla Powerwall 3 for our home. Beyond solar had the best quote by far and they excelled in their service.They arranged a walk through of the solution, coordinated to have our meter upgraded then booked a date to complete the installation.On the day, the teams arrived on time and meticulously worked on installing the solar panel systems, battery, gateway along with all the wiring.Once completed they installed the Tesla phone app which is fantastic in monitoring and managing the system and usage.The system is working well and we can already see a huge reduction in power we take from our energy provider. We are generating almost a 100% power through our solar and battery.The install team was super professional, thorough and took pride in their work.All the teams from Arham at the introduction to MK and his outfit managing the install were brilliant.I wouldn’t recommend anyone else other than Beyond Solar.Thank you Beyond Solar team.

Price-wise, the quote was a standout and after a day of fact checking on the SolarQuotes website, going with Beyond Solar was a no brainer.  They organised the installation of the smart meter and everything happened exactly how & when they said.  I took a work-from-home day for the installation and discretely overheard the supervisor directing his people to rework stuff that he wasn't 100% happy with.  All up, a delighted customer.
The install went really well. Pre install communication was good, and installation day went to plan.Very tidy and helpful with information, polite and hassle free.

We recently installed an 11.4 kWh solar system and Powerwall 3 with Beyond Solar at a very competitive price, and the entire experience was exceptional. From start to finish, their professionalism, expertise, and customer service were top-notch.Arham, our consultant, was outstanding. He gave a thorough explanation of the system’s features and benefits, helping us understand all the options available. Pricing was transparent, and he worked with us to find the perfect solution tailored to our home and budget.The installation team exceeded our expectations. They arrived on time, worked efficiently, and took the time to explain how everything operates. They patiently answered all our questions, ensuring we were confident with the system.Since the installation, the solar system has been performing exactly as promised, and we couldn’t be happier with the results. We highly recommend Beyond Solar for anyone considering solar energy solutions!

Saad and the team were helpful, thorough and efficient from initial inquiry to final invoice.  Everything in Beyond Solar's offer happened exactly as, when and for how much they quoted.  We could not ask for a better outcome.
Great advice and service, answered all my questions and provided a great system with panels and battery to meet my needs. The install went without a problem and the team were polite and very tidy.

These guys are the best, installers were polite and knowledgeable, answered every question I asked, And Saad in sales was a pleasure to work with, giving me a great deal. I highly recommend to anyone wanting solar.

The process from start to finish was very professional. The installation by Hussein and his offsider was excellent, worked hard all day and gave me a very thorough run through on how everything worked. Both the guys were very polite and left the property clean and tidy.

These guys are the best. The Installers were very friendly and professional, answered all my questions and informed me of a lot of things I did not know. and Saad Siddiqui was great. He was thorough and courteous, It was an absolute pleasure to deal with him. I highly recommend them to anyone considering  a solar install

Saad from the sales team was very knowledgeable and helpful to design the best value for money system for me.I initially intended to go for solar and battery solutions but ended up with solar only for now with a battery ready inverter.Would recommend Beyond solar to my friends and family.
Install of the above was very good was professional, on time, first class with equipment described in Solar Quotes as No.1

From the moment I spoke to Saad I knew I had found someone qualified, knowledgable and patient. Beyond Solar were streets ahead of the other two quotes in terms of attention to detail and designing specifically for our complex two storey house. We were on a steep learning curve and Saad walked us through each option and decision. Unlike the others there was a discount for paying up front rather than using govt sponsored interest free loan. Our annual savings look to be $4,656.82 annually.Customer service was great. Hussein and his team arrived at 8.30 and left around 4pm. Worked non stop to put 30 panels and a Tesla 3 battery which includes the inverter inside it. Yes, it was a Musk moral dilemma but Tesla is state of the art. Hussein was so knowledgable finishing with helping us download the app to monitor activity on our phones. I would wholly recommend Beyond Solar. You don’t have this quality service unless you have depth of skill, happy customers and integrity as a company. Again thanks Saad!
Knowledgeable team and great customer service.Rep never tried to upsell anything and always checked to see whether he had answered all my questions.

Beyond Solar has been great with their service especially tailoring to my needs and budget wise. Do like to thank Arham Ahmed who I have been in touch with.On the day of the installation it was a smooth and no issues came across from the installers side. Was then shown how the Inverter works and what has been installed. Sam explained everything clearly. Once again thank you again.
Nice tidy job completed promptly.Friendly installers happy to answer questions.

The process with Beyond Solar was very smooth. The price was very competitive for a 10.5kW system, so it was a no brainer to go with them. The system was installed in 2 weeks time once I moved in to my place. I highly recommend Beyond Solar!

Sales team were very professional and efficient. The representative was helpful in assisting to determine what size system we were after and could be catered for on our roof and within our budget. Received both quotes for different system sizes within 2 hours of discussing with the representative what we were after.Installation was smooth, the team came out to measure and set up the night prior. During the installation day the team made sure to keep me in the loop with what they were doing such as having to shut the power off for a short period of time. Very polite and tidy - left the area the same as before they came to install.Customer service was very good. The team made sure to connect me to the app and show me how to use it prior to finishing the job. Got a call post installation to ensure I was happy with the whole process.

Over all good job, despite some minor inconveniences. There was some issues with wifi connection that could have been easily sorted if the installer explain the process thoroughly in the first place. However the resolution was quite easy and timely with chatting with customer service. The only downside of the customer service is they can be hard to reach as they are always busy and call almost always through to "voicemail". If they tighten those ups, I reckon they'll easily earn 5 stars consistently.

Our system has only been active for 2 days, so the following is our experience up to nowUpfront sales team was helpful, though did not follow through with all that we discussed. The idea was to quote on the inclusion of a battery solution with the option to delay the battery purchase and install. I.e. lock in a battery price now. I'm sure the Beyond team can still assist if I request, I'm relaxed with this oversight and battery prices at present and maybe into the future may not be viable for our home.The team at Beyond are extremely responsive to questions pre purchase, during installation scheduling, during installation and after installation.Installation was smooth with the installation team turning up on time, taking care to limit broken tiles and clean up at completion. Most of the tiles the team replaced were broken prior to installation and in areas on the roof the team was not even working on, so I cannot thank them enough for taking the time and care whilst up on the second floor of the house to replace these.There are a few items during installation that need to be need to be brought up with the Beyond team, the most important is sarking penetrations. The team left a large sarking penetration open that they used to draw and feed cables down to the meter box. Whilst opening the sarking is not ideal it sometimes cannot be avoided. It should however be repaired as this component is an essential safety guard for catching water that leaks through the tiled roof.Commissioning of the system was delayed, I have not caught up with the team as to what the primary issue was. Our system is an Enphase micro-inverter solution and it may have encountered the dreaded inverter communication line noise issue, ref: https://support.enphase.com/s/article/How-does-noise-affect-power-line-communications.Now that the system is commissioned , accessing the the Enphase monitoring service is quick and efficient after the receipt of an activation e-mail from Enphase. By the end of the morning I had accessed the monitoring interface, entered billing information and now need to be patient for the data set to grow before making too many adjustments to loadBeyond also install a WallBox EV charger. The team were more than happy to Accommodate installing the charger in a location some distance from the meter box with little evidence of external conduits visible. Beyond's sparky's are professional and clean.SolarQuotes has played an integral role in understanding solar, some of the pitfalls to be careful of, I think I broke all 10 of them ;), and ultimately organising quotes. The SolarQuotes site is a wealth of knowledge for somebody starting out on the solar journeyThanks

Everything was a great experience. Saad was super efficient in quoting and very patient with my many questions. MK provided terrific communication and updates on the preperation for the installation was flexible with dates. Adam and his team were excellent with their installation, we went through all of the options first and he provided reqular updates through the day on progress. Adam was very clean and precise with this electrical work, took the time to do the job correctly and left everything tidy when done. Overall great customer service.
Great service. They helped with organising the grid connection. Delivered on time.

After shopping around going ahead with beyond solar was the best decision we made. Such an easy and smooth process. Very punctual honest and reliable. The whole team was a delight to deal with and very helpful.
The sales person I dealt with was great. They helped me find the best system for my needs. Everything about the installation was smooth and now my bills are about a quarter of what my bills were.

I’ve had the pleasure of using Beyond Solar for both solar panel installation and now, battery installation, and I couldn’t be happier with their service.From the beginning, their customer service has been outstanding. They’re easy to contact, quick to respond, and always willing to assist with any questions or concerns. Their after-sales support is just as impressive, ensuring you feel supported long after the initial installation is complete.What stood out the most during the installation was the quality of their work. They hid all the cables behind the wall at no extra cost, leaving a clean and professional finish. Now with the battery installation, they’re even setting up the backup system free of charge.Beyond Solar provides top-tier service that goes above and beyond, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable and professional solar or battery installation services.

I am extremely satisfied with the service and pricing from Beyond Solar. I would like to especially commend installer ZiCheng and his colleague for their outstanding work. ZiCheng took the time to thoroughly explain the installation process and the functionality of the solar system, ensuring that I fully understood everything. Their professionalism and attention to detail were exceptional.A special thank you also goes to Muhieddine, who provided comprehensive explanations during my inquiry about purchasing solar panels. He went above and beyond, dedicating ample time to educate both my wife and me on the best options for our needs. His thoroughness and commitment to helping us make informed decisions were greatly appreciated.My power bill has dropped significantly. I wish I had made the switch sooner, but I'm very glad I chose Beyond Solar.

My experience throughout the entire process with Beyond Solar was smooth and seamless. They provided the most competitive quote for my needs (without any negotiation) and the installation process managed by Adam was exceptional. The team are true professionals and I cannot recommend them highly enough! Thank you and great job! You have a happy camper here!

Easy quoting and sales process. Competitive pricing on Jinko 8kW system for a ground mounted off-grid install. Neat and tidy install with clean wiring and clear labelling. Performance is great so far. Highly recommend.

Beyond Solar were open to discussing options and working to get the best result for us. Others seemed more intent on providing a 'package'. Saad, our Beyond Solar sales consultant patiently worked through many questions and unpacked the data that all solar providers use to make a system look viable or attractive. Saad provided honest and knowledgeable explanations which allowed us to make clearer comparisons. He modelled different battery/non-battery scenarios for us. This was invaluable in helping us make decisions for the system we purchased.Communications with the Beyond Solar team were seamless and installation scheduling was prompt. I am impressed with how the install team, led by Huss, turned up on the scheduled day and installed the system with no fuss. The team was courteous, tidy, and efficient....they have done this before!! The installation finished with an informative explanation of the system and the Sungrow solar monitoring app.Our new system has been performing beyond expectations so far - thank you Beyond Solar!

I obtained 3 quotes from your list of preferred installers and 2 more not on your list. The 2 not on your list had the highest cost quoted while the silver and gold installers had the lowest quotes. It seemed to me that there is an inverse relationship between quoted price and quality of installation. The higher on your list the more affordable the quote!The installation was done in one day and the system is currently working fine. The site was left very clean and tidy and there was no damage to the roof.They helped me order the smart switch from my energy retailer and the company organised the registration with AusGrid.I am no eagerly waiting for the battery installation.

After some time clarifying the exact needs, this provider came out on top for adding batteries to  our existing system (Beyond solar also  previously extended our solar) . They recommended leaving the existing inverter in place (as it was a good quality one) and we wanted a 3 phase inverter for the batteries to match our 3 phase house.The installation guys were amazing.

reviews.review_description: From start to end was a very smooth, efficient, customer focused process and always answer your questions. They were on time and installation went as planned. From install to grid and after sale support was a 100%, no issues at allHighly recommend
Easy to deal with, flexible with panel and inverter options. Systems has been working well since.

I chose Beyond Solar based on the 3 quotes through Solar Quotes. The team at Beyond Solar were friendly and responsive and provided the best value for money for a Tier 1 solution.They arrived on time as arranged and installed, were friendly and efficient and got everything done in a day on my double storey townhouse. They ran me through the installation, ensured that I could connect to the system to monitor it and took all the rubbish with them - couldn’t even tell they’d been here after they left.6 months in everything is working as designed. Very happy with the service.

- Sales and quoting was transparent with every cost explained. Pricing was very competitive.- Installation was swift and installers were friendly and explained all the features of the new system.- Grid connection was handled entirely by the team and was smooth as well.

I'm extremely happy with my solar system, it has been a seamless experience with no issues at all. The team were professional and friendly, and also answered all of my detailed questions to ensure I picked exactly what I wanted. I will absolutely go back to Beyond Solar when I'm ready to upgrade.

I was recommended Beyond Solar and I am pleased I was.  After receiving 4 quotes they were not the cheapest or the most expensive.  I chose them due to the recommendation and they proved very reliable in all their communications and acted the most professional.  Their follow up systems and comms work well without being a them becoming a pest with spam calls.It was a pleasure to do business with them.
Awesome experience  3 years ago. They look after my roof, clean up after their installation and solar is going well.Polite team, good customer service .I recommend them easily to my friends

They worked with me about my requirements and suggested a good system to install. They also accommodated some changes that happened meanwhile due to my distributor’s delay in upgrading my line to 3 phase.The installation was also very clean and professional.

Of all of the installers we had quotes from, Beyond Solar were the most attentive, offered the greatest solution, and best overall outcome for our shady roof. Overall cannot fault them for their installation of price. Would recommend seeking them for a quote for your solar install!
The process was pretty quick and installed within a couple hours.

Saad has to be the most knowledgeable solar sales person I spoke to out of 7 companies which I spoke to, this really made me feel confident with my purchase. Even went as far as answering my questions out of office hours.Huss lead the installation team, discussed the best positioning on the day and even got the battery base out to show me how it would fit in his recommended position. Although the day was super windy, the install is super tidy and the crew cleaned up all their mess even going as far as sweeping out my garage from leaves that had blown in throughout the day. Huss went over how the whole system works and even walked me through the app before he went. The small issue I have with the install is where the conduit comes through the edging on the ceiling, although I'm not making down points as this is 100% fixable, Other then that the work in the roof, on the roof, in the switchboard and on the wall is amazing.It's only been a day since the install but just looking at the results for today I am amazed, my battery was full before 10:30am and has covered the cost of running 3 split systems and still been making more then enough electricity.

We had previous quotes last year and the salespeople just confused us and then left us with a hefty price tag. We didn’t go forward.Beyond Solar contacted us quickly and explained it to us in a way we understood and had confidence with them to move forward.It was an easy, pain free installation. They cleaned up as they went, explained the app and ensured we had online access.Definitely recommend.

Sales and quoting was straightforward. Our system requirements and installation is fairly simple so no onsite visit was required.The installers were punctual, Adam was very friendly and provided all the information we were after - throughout both the installation process and how to operate the system. They were clean and tidy, treating our place like they would their own.I am very happy overall with Beyond Solar and our installed system!
Easy process from quote to installinstallers were on time efficient and cleaned up after the installremoved existing solar and installed new system all in one day

I have used Beyond Solar 4 times now, three time for myself (Home, business and Investment Property) and each time Pawan has excelled in service and price. Pawan / Beyond have configured the panes to maximise our production and return of investment.Site teams are friendly and efficient and after they have finished, they clean up and ensure the system is ready for our energy provider.After sales i cannot comment on as none of the systems have had any issues in the 2 - 5 yrs since installation

The quoting process was all done remotely, they wouldn't come out to the site until installation and any adjustments needed would be assessed then (possibly at my cost)The installers were punctual and very polite, explaining all that they were doing and working out final placement for battery and inverter. They tidied up at each stage leaving very little behind. They only cracked one roof tile.I don't know if they were meant to organise the network to reconfigure the smart meter for FIT but that didn't happen until after our electricity retailer notified them.
An integrated service from initial inquiry to providing answers to queries to installation.

Sales/quoting was comprehensive. They were happy to make multiple quotes, modifying to suit my requirements.Installers were polite and punctual.They didn’t organise the grid connection afterwards but I knew that this was the case from the beginning. Beyond Solar explained they didn’t have the relationship with my retailer (Energy Australia) to do this.I read their web site to learn they adhere to all the safety standards. Cabling in the roof is labelled appropriately, for example. The installers didn’t wear or fit safety measures against falls off the roof, however. That was my biggest surprise.My quote was not done on-site. In hindsight, I would insist on this as the panels wouldn’t fit as designed so the installers discussed alternatives with me and found an alternate, perfectly acceptable way to install the panels.

Everyone was easy for me from start to finish. I’m an aged pensioner and not very computer savvy and the salesman helped me all the way, he had so much patience.Four men came from Sydney to the Riverina to install and I couldn’t have asked for better people, polite punctual and friendly, one even put the app on my phone.I would highly recommend this company to everyone.

Despite pre-installation communications only being by phone Saad from Beyond Solar created a better configured, better capacity design than other on site and on-line providers from which I received quotes from. Installation team excellent (Adam talked through all on-day aspects and fixed a minor issue with my mains board for no labour cost), post installation responsive and organised all paperwork to update with electricity supplier. System works well and is delivering a little in excess of quoted Kwh.

It's been 5 years since we installed the solar system by Beyond Solar. they help us to choose a good quality, money value system and it's been working so well and no issues at all. when we have some questions, MK always there to help. His professionalism, prompt reply is very impressive.

I have used Beyond Solar twice now in three years. The first solar system they designed for me paid itself off well in advance of their estimates. The inverter broke and they were seamless in organising and installing a replacement. I was so impressed I came back for a second system.Saad is my sales guy and he was honest, open and very informative.MK and the tech support team are amazing. Real stars of the after sales support.

Aftercare support was excellent. Post some work by an electrician there was an issue with the inverter not being connected to the main switchboard correctly. I rang up the Beyond Solar for their assistance and MK their Technical Manager explained the issue to me and also directed the electrician to fault fix. Post issue resolution, he ensured the tests were down remotely to ensure there are no further faults.Would highly recommend Beyond Solar for their professionalism and attention to detail. Thanks MK for your support.

To be fair the quote documents contained all of the information required to define the system and to tick all of the boxes in the solar quotes checklist, but they were much harder to find than some other companies that quoted

We are very happy with the product and installation Beyond Solar provided. Not only they have very competitive pricing, they also use reputable brands and the communication and installation were smooth. The solar panels have been working very well, and we even got credit for our electricity bills!

I went with Beyond Solar after they were recommended by Solar Quotes and a colleague who had used them. Sales quoting process was easy to understand and responsive to questions. Install involved some of the hardest workers I've met, punctual and got the full 13.2kw system installed in a day.
easy sales and quoting systemcould not fault the installation teasystem was only installed a few days a go and the grid connection has not yet been finalised
Sales and installers were friendly and professional, very good experience
We would highly recommend Beyond Solar in all aspects from sales through to installation.
The salesperson was very professional and upfront. The installation was once again professional and well done.The customer service so far, has been without fault.

Saad and the team were great, the initialQuote was done online and communication throughout was transparent and clear. The team did a superb job installing and configuring the system, arrived on time and cleaned up after completion. Helped explain and setup the Enphase app on the day. Support team answered any questions we had, nightgown recommend.

Over the phone quote, regular reminders came across as a bit of a hard sell, nearly went with another installer if it escalated.Install was top notch.  Arrived on time, quite, efficient, and diligent work by roof installer and electrician who did a high quality job.After sales follow ups and customer relation contact.  Grid connection was all seamless.
Tony the sales person was very helpful did not have to wait long for installation arrived on time schedule for installation. Grid connection was arranged by Beyond Solar

Beyond Solar and Saad was great and very accommodating easing any concerns in particular issues with my roof. Saad really listened to my concerns and provided great advice on what they can do. He even went to the trouble of organising the electrician to speak to me to gain comfort before committing to anything. The install process was just as smooth. Adam /Huss and the team was fantastic on the install day. Adam was even able to come up with a better solution on the day with how the cables would be run etc after seeing the roof and agreeing on the layout. The team kept me informed throughout the whole process. Everyone at Beyond Solar went above expectations and I highly recommend them!

My first contact with Saad from Beyond Solar was great. The Beyond Solar pre-sales team was excellent. They seemed knowledgeable about the products they sell and were really responsive. However, once I've paid the deposit the service went downhill.I first received a quote on the 29th of October, hoping to get the installation done in December after moving into the new house. My second email contained the building plans for the house with the exact measurements of the property. We will come back to that in a bit.After having to chase them in the second half of November, they finally provided me with an installation date on the 2nd of December, scheduled for the 9th.The installation team showed up on the morning of the 9th with a ladder that didn't reach the top of the roof. It is a two-storey building with high ceilings. Yes, it is fairly high. However, that shouldn't have been a surprise as I provided the building plans early on. The team packed up again and said they would contact me later in the day. I didn't hear back. I gave them a call later that day and they said that the team is discussing different options to access the roof. That's fine, but for some reason evaluating these options took another 1 1/2 weeks. Surely there are only so many options to access a roof and it shouldn't take longer than a couple of hours to come up with a plan.In the end, they suggested a scaffold to access the roof. That sounded like a good idea until they told me that it would add an extra $3000 on top of my $9320 bill. Basically, it just got 30% more expensive. I asked them for cheaper alternatives, but they said they could maybe reduce the price by a couple of hundred dollars.I asked a builder for a quote and was told the cost for a couple of days including install and tear down of a scaffold would be $1500. However, Beyond Solar wasn't willing to price match that quote and said that I could organize the scaffold separately. That would mean that any risk in regards to bad weather (which we had a lot in December) would be carried by me and I would have had to coordinate two companies.Renting a cherry picker crane was another (cheaper) option, but they said it wasn't possible due to access. Which the builder said wasn't the case.Because the installation would have been pushed to January, they would have received a reduced rebate from the government. A cost they would have had to cover. It sure seemed like they tried to make that up with an overpriced scaffolding quote or hoped that I would cancel and go with a different installer.Ultimately that's what I did. As a result of Beyond Solar not properly reading the building plans or doing a pre-install inspection, my installation is now delayed until February and I lost more than $500 in rebates.My recommendation, save yourself the headache and find a different installer.Update - 19/1/2021 Jens response to Beyond Solars reply:> You asked us for a refund so we gave you a full refund immediately, however you then called us back to complain that instead of a refund we should’ve given you a discount.That is not true, I specifically asked for them to propose a different solution or consider matching the price I received from another scaffolder who provided the scaffold during the building of the house. A 30% increase in the original price was rather unreasonable.>We said we'd be happy for you to use him and you refused to use your own guy and demanded we price match.I merely got a quote from another scaffolder to understand what a fair price was. It wasn't "my own guy".> We spent almost 2 weeks trying to find workable solutions for you and getting quotes from various companies who specialize in difficult access.It's certainly not standard access, but it's also not as difficult as they made it sound. They didn't bother with a site visit before the installation and didn't look at the building plans I provided.> We kept you in the loop throughout.They did not. After the installation date, I didn't hear back from them for a couple of days. They never proactively contacted me, it was always me who had to hunt them down. Happy to provide the email thread as proof if required.Their reply is a typical "not our fault" response. Of course, they conveniently forgot to mention the loss of rebate and that they would have had to cover it if the job went ahead.They failed to mention that it took 2 weeks to work out access. It is a high roof, but there are really only 2 options (aside from a ladder) to access a roof. Not sure what took them too long. When I enquired throughout the 2 weeks I was told our team is still looking at different soluions.The fact is that their lack of upfront diligence (a site visit or simply looking at the building plans) ended up costing them a few hours coming out to realize they didn't have the right equipment and cost me $500+ in missed rebates.
